AssertionError: Pagination (Next/Prev buttons) should NOT be visible when search returns no results
assert not True
TC-UM-015: Search with no match → no-data message

AssertionError: Status filter dropdown should have cursor:'pointer', got 'default'
assert 'default' == 'pointer'
  
  - pointer
  + default
TC-UM-044: Filter dropdown triggers show pointer cursor on hover

AssertionError: Location filter placeholder should be 'Search by location', got 'Filter by location...'
assert 'filter by location...' == 'search by location'
  
  - search by location
  + filter by location...
TC-UM-046: Location filter placeholder text is 'Search by location'

AssertionError: 'Clear All' should NOT appear when searching by name/ID/email. Per design it is reserved for Status/Dating Mode/Location filter chips. The search field should show a cancel icon (×) instead.
assert not True
TC-UM-048: 'Clear All' NOT shown when searching by name/ID/email; cancel icon shown instead

AssertionError: Option 'Dating Mode Active' is incorrectly prefixed with 'Dating Mode'. Labels should be 'Active' and 'Inactive' only — matching the Status filter style.
assert not True
 +  where True = <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x7f4d194d0e40>('dating mode ')
 +    where <built-in method startswith of str object at 0x7f4d194d0e40> = 'dating mode active'.startswith
 +      where 'dating mode active' = <built-in method lower of str object at 0x7f4d1a5c4800>()
 +        where <built-in method lower of str object at 0x7f4d1a5c4800> = 'Dating Mode Active'.lower
 +          where 'Dating Mode Active' = <built-in method strip of str object at 0x7f4d1a5c4800>()
 +            where <built-in method strip of str object at 0x7f4d1a5c4800> = 'Dating Mode Active'.strip
TC-UM-052: Dating Mode options show 'Active'/'Inactive', not 'Dating Mode Active'/'Dating Mode Inactive'
